newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lack of democracy risk for Uganda growth-US source.
newsitem.headline: Lack of democracy risk for Uganda growth-US source.

text.p: The absence of multi-party democracy represents the biggest risk to sustainable economic growth in Uganda, the top U.S. aid official said on Tuesday.

Uganda is the 12th or 13th-fastest growing economy in the world and saw its foreign investment double last year, Brian Atwood, administrator for the U.S. Agency for International Development, told a news briefing.

The Uganda government is tackling one potential obstacle to growth, environmental degradation and deforestation, but has not addressed the absence of democratic rule, said Atwood, who is in Paris for a meeting of the OECD's Development Assistance Committee.
"That is the biggest risk to sustainable economic growth in Uganda," Atwood said.
He said President Yoweri Museveni argued that it was hard to manage a multi-party democracy in a peasant society, but added that was the argument used by past South Korean governments.
